source_state: Both measurements ran with the physical Task-return and game migration uncommitted. The rejected comparison predates wait-before-probe ordering; the accepted one includes it. Raw setup HEAD/status, exact source digests and actual captured build provenance distinguish them. Paused Editor/UI/Dialogue work in setup status was not part of this implementation.
run_command: cargo +1.95.0 nextest run --manifest-path samples/two-level-game/Cargo.toml --locked --offline --release --features desktop,cost-measurement --test development_notifications --run-ignored only --test-threads=1 --no-fail-fast --no-tests fail --success-output immediate

environment.CARGO_TARGET_DIR: The original absolute Nara target directory, reused serially by outer and nested Cargo.
environment.NARA_DEVELOPMENT_NOTIFICATIONS_OUTPUT: A new absolute temporary JSON path per comparison; original cleanup precedes create_new output.

workload.order: periodic/notification, notification/periodic, periodic/notification within each placement
workload.variant_difference: One exact IDLE_RECONCILE_INTERVAL constant, 2 versus 250 ms; both variants use actual native watchers and the same loop implementation within each comparison.
workload.counter_window: Last validated Capture response through the next one, including endpoint requests and parent response-observation overhead.
workload.cleanup: Original game Close, joined watcher diagnostics, exact original active-generation native containment/readers/output receipt, then original Fixture removal.

observed_desktop_adapter.model_and_driver: Not exposed by this child receipt; not inferred from another consumer.

rejected_comparison.run_scope: One comparison in a four-test native cohort; three actual rebuild/adoption workflows pass separately in that cohort.
rejected_comparison.correction: Wait before another inbox probe after responding unless a hint is pending. Keep the initial immediate probe, notification/reconciliation probes, acknowledgement-before-receive, original limits and native maintenance. Counters and numerical gates are unchanged.

ordinary_desktop_cost_game.source_scope: After physical-return migration, before wait-before-probe correction.

limits: Task return is an observation, not an admission freeze, worker join, complete game checkpoint or native rollback permission.
Both variants use the maintained implementation and native watchers. This is not a matched historical-binary comparison.
The 100 ms selected-request gate excludes startup, compilation and gameplay preparation and remains cooperative.
Windows wait and CPU accounting are quantized. No stable CPU, power, scanout, GPU-duration or latency-tail gain follows.
Parent response polling remains 10 ms; fewer child checks do not prove faster end-to-end response.
Vendor internal wakes, notification-loss reconciliation, foreign execution and complete Foundation/R12 remain open.
